newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hashimoto to meet Clinton in Denver on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Hashimoto to meet Clinton in Denver on Thursday.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto will meet U.S. President Bill Clinton in Denver on Thursday ahead of the weekend Group of Seven (G7) summit meeting, the Japanese government spokesman said on Tuesday.
Hashimoto will arrive in Denver on Thursday afternoon and hold talks with Clinton after his arrival, Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama told a news conference.

Hashimoto is scheduled to hold bilateral talks with Russian President Boris Yeltsin, German Chancellor Helmut Kohl, British Prime Minister Tony Blair and French President Jacques Chirac the following day, Kajiyama said.
